name: Cloudflare Skills
summary: Cloudflare's official Agent Skills and plugin for building on Workers, the Agents SDK, Durable Objects, Sandbox, Wrangler and the wider Developer Platform; bundles the Cloudflare MCP server.
description: Installs as a native plugin in Codex (`codex plugin marketplace add cloudflare/skills`), Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add cloudflare/skills`), VS Code/GitHub Copilot and Cursor, or as plain skills via `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/skills`. Skills include cloudflare (product discovery), agents-sdk, durable-objects, sandbox, wrangler, cf-cli, workers-best-practices, workers-profiling, web-perf, turnstile, email service and Cloudflare One. The plugin bundles only the main remote `cloudflare` MCP server (Code Mode).
